snippet.title: PSX Longplay [174] Chrono Trigger (Part 1 of 5)
snippet.description:
http://www.longplays.org

Played by: Stenio Henrique

Hey is Stenio, This is my first RPG longplay for World of Longplays. I spent a lot to make this longplay. And the work was hard PSXJin is an emulator that needs improvement but still served very well. It took me one month to finish the game and recorded 3 times (the first time after 6 hours of play he had no more sound inexplicably after defeat Heckran). Is not perfect because I'm new to RPG's (is my weak point ^^ I am not master of RPG's as xRavenXP, Valis77, Tsunao and others.). In a few moments the sound in Truce Canyon will give a horrible shriek.
I fell in love with this story and wanted to have used all characters with 100% of spells. but understand that my computer is weak and it is difficult to record with PSXJin. I spent a lot of time training the characters to level up and not lose to Lavos (I hate this boss). All the characters are charming and the soundtrack too. Differences in Chrono Trigger for the SNES & PS1 are in anime cutscenes and a final scene that shows the possible sequel to the game Chrono Cross (xRavenXP leave the continuation in your hands my friend ^^). 

Thanks to the xRavenXP encode and for showing me this game , this longplay is dedicated for you. Thanks also for the tips Tsunao to defeat Lavos. And especially for the cubex55 (World Of Longplays) Thanks for everything.

Have fun.

Note: None of the optional quests (side-quests) was made (only beaten Rust Tyrano and continued training to defeat Lavos & Lavos Core) -
Disclaimer: Most videos by World of Longplays use SaveStates!
